correctness.rationale: For Steiner 2-(v,k,1) nontrivial designs with r=(v-1)/(k-1), b=vr/k, the height-two incidence order complex is exactly its bipartite graph. Point-root weights are 0 (root), 1 (other points), k (through-root blocks), k+1 (remaining blocks): the k-stage graph is a tree, and the final cycle rank is beta=(k-1)b-v+1. For a block root the k-stage graph is connected with 1+k(r-1) blocks, cycle rank alpha=(k-1)(v-k), while remaining disjoint blocks add beta-alpha at k+1. Graph inclusions inject on H1 integrally (no two-cells), so the degree 0 and 1 intervals including half-open endpoints and persistence forever follow exactly over every field. No higher bars. All poset points/blocks have at least 2 incomparable upper/lower neighbors (no beat points); Stong core uniqueness plus the published 80 STS(15) count establish 80 nonhomotopy finite spaces with identical multisets of all rooted barcodes. An independent Fano-design graph filtration at every root reproduced k-stage ranks (0,8) and beta=8, with direct counting of all full-cycle stages.
residual_risks: No claim that the incidence order complexes are pairwise distinct ordinary homotopy types: conclusion is explicitly finite-space homotopy and relies on beat-point-free core.
